title: 和室・洋室・会議室の小物
theme: small decorative details for Japanese, Western and meeting rooms, realistic photographic materials

cells.name: 掛軸
cells.prompt: a Japanese hanging scroll painting of misty mountains and pine trees in sumi ink on silk, mounted with a muted brocade border, no text, no calligraphy, no seal, filling the whole square

cells.name: 座布団の生地
cells.prompt: indigo dyed cotton fabric with a small white kasuri ikat pattern, about 0.5 m across

cells.name: 漆塗り
cells.prompt: deep black urushi lacquer with a glossy finish and a faint red layer showing at worn spots, about 0.6 m across

cells.name: アンティーク真鍮
cells.prompt: antique brushed brass with warm golden tone and darker tarnish in places, about 0.4 m across

cells.name: 暖炉のレンガ
cells.prompt: soot-darkened red firebrick wall laid in running bond, about 1 m across

cells.name: 本の背表紙
cells.prompt: a full bookshelf row of old cloth-bound book spines in muted red, green, brown and navy, with gilt bands but no readable text, no letters, filling the whole square

cells.name: プレゼン画面
cells.prompt: a glowing presentation slide on a large screen showing a clean bar chart and line graph in blue and teal on white, no text, no numbers, no letters, filling the whole square

cells.name: テラゾー床
cells.prompt: polished grey terrazzo floor with scattered white, black and rust coloured stone chips, seen from directly above, about 1 m across

cells.name: 観葉植物の葉
cells.prompt: dense green tropical houseplant leaves overlapping, glossy monstera and pothos leaves filling the frame, about 0.6 m across
